III</ls>] .²1 Doing, execution, performance, accomplishment; उपचार˚, धर्म˚; प्रत्युक्तं हि प्रणयिषु सतामीप्सितार्थक्रियैव <ls>Me. 116</ls>. .²2 An action, act, business, undertaking; प्रणयिक्रिया <ls>V. 4. 15</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 4</ls>. .²3 Activity, bodily action, labour. .²4 Teaching, instruction; क्रिया हि वस्तूपहिता प्रसीदति <ls>R. 3. 29</ls>. क्रिया हि द्रव्यं विनयति नाद्रव्यम् <ls>Kau. A. 1. 5</ls>. .²5 Possession of some act (as of singing, dancing <ab>&c.</ab>), knowledge; शिष्टा क्रिया कस्यचिदात्मसंस्था <ls>M. 1. 16</ls>. .²6 Practice (<ab>opp.</ab> शास्त्र theory). .²7 A literary work, composition; शृणुत मनोभिरवहितैः क्रियामिमां कालिदासस्य <ls>V. 1. 2</ls>; कालिदासस्य क्रियायां कथं परिषदो बहुमानः <ls>M. 1</ls>. .²8 A purificatory rite, a religious rite or ceremony; <ls>Ms. 10. 43</ls>. .²9 An expiatory rite, expiation. .²10 .³({%a%}) The ceremony of offering oblations to the deceased ancestors (श्राद्ध). .³({%b%}) Obsequies. .²11 Worship; त्रैतादिषु हरेरर्चा क्रियायै कविभिः ऽकृता <ls>Bhāg. 7. 14. 39</ls>. .²12 Medical treatment, application of remedies, cure; शीतक्रिया <ls>M. 4</ls> cold remedies. .²13 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Action, the general idea expressed by a verb. .²14 Motion. .²15 Especially, motion as one of the seven categories of the Vaiśeṣikas; see कर्मन्. .²16 (In law) Judicial investigation by human means (witnesses <ab>&c.</ab>) or by ordeals. .²17 Burden of proof; क्रिया स्याद्वादिनोर्द्वयोः; द्वयोरपि वादिनोः क्रिया प्राप्नोति <ls>V. May.</ls> .²18 A verb. .²19 A noun of action. .²20 Disquisition. .²21 Study. .²22 Means, expedients. .²23 Instrument, implement. .²24 A construction; कूपप्रपापुष्करिणीवनानां चक्रुः क्रियास्तत्र च धर्मकामाः <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 12</ls>. .²25 Spirit (अध्यात्म) ?; द्रव्यक्रियाकारकाख्यं धूत्वा यान्त्यपुनर्भवम् <ls>Bhāg. 12. 6. 38</ls>.
